revision_immutability: insert_only; id and canonical bytes digest are unique

activation_authority.record: append-only activation event with revision_id, action, effective_at, actor_id, reason and event_id
activation_authority.eligible_at_mint: the latest activation event with effective_at <= mint_time is ACTIVATE
activation_authority.mutation: activation history is never updated or deleted

selection_at_mint.predicate: activation eligible and valid_from <= mint_time and valid_until >= mint_time + max_session_duration_ms + settlement_grace_ms
selection_at_mint.order: greatest valid_from, then lexicographically greatest id

staging.overlap_selection: the greatest valid_from wins for new mints
required_checks: margin and token ceilings are safe integers

existing_session.rule: continue with the complete pricing snapshot and digest persisted at mint even after a newer revision activates
existing_session.reconciliation: uses only the RealtimeTurn persisted snapshot, never the current active revision

capability_binding.rule: capability is schema-validated per session; static protocol/model fields remain exact while wallet revision id and digest are selected dynamically
capability_binding.digest: SDK recomputes RFC8785 SHA-256 over the full HTTP capability and requires the same digest in token binding, session.open, and session.created
capability_binding.sdk_release_required: only for a schema or static protocol/model change, not for a new same-schema wallet revision

operations.alert_owner: RealtimeWalletPricingLifecycleService evaluates at API startup, every native mint, pricing health probe, and deployment preflight; it emits metadata-only revision id, threshold and remaining_ms
operations.alert_test: fake clock asserts exactly one threshold transition at 7d, 3d and 1d per revision and process lifetime; repeated checks inside one band are deduplicated
operations.production_preflight: an eligible revision must cover max session plus grace and a schema-valid successor must be inserted before the seven-day threshold and activated before the predecessor can no longer cover the mint horizon
operations.rollback: append DEACTIVATE for the successor; optionally append ACTIVATE for a predecessor only if it still satisfies the mint horizon; never mutate or delete a revision referenced by a token, session, turn, or UsageEvent
